title: Give Perfect Paradox To Saint-14 - Vision Of The Future Cutscene (Destiny 2)
description: The ending of the "Corridors Of Time Part I" mission. The historical moment when we give Saint-14 his Shotgun and Ghost shows him a hopeful future.
source_rights_note: Third-party gameplay capture by arkangelofkaos of Bungie in-engine footage. The uploader's contribution is limited to the capture. Used under Bungie's fan-content forbearance, which is explicitly not permission, is revocable, and permits non-commercial fan creations only.
